lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments with narrow inter-line spacing in the posterior region and wider spacing in the mid-torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation visible on the upper portion of the fifth stripe from the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three mid-body stripes show termination points in the lower ventral half of the torso, failing to reach the lower boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of approximately 3 distinct spots on the upper hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Backward-sweeping lyrate curve at approximately 40 degrees from the skull base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Approximate 1.5 ratio of tip-to-tip span relative to total horn base width.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tips represent approximately 15 percent of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial chevron, white throat patches, and high-contrast white banding on lower limbs.
